state: source + focused tests + local scale measurement; hosted proof pending

design.caller: services/research/alpha_templates/schedule.py TemplateEvaluationScheduler, started as a thread by alpha_replication.replication_controller.main (alpha-replication-worker); no API route starts it
design.due_rule: newest stored governed trading day is newer than the last evaluated day AND the last cycle started at least 7 days ago
design.resume: cycle state (pinned governed snapshot, symbols, fixed batches, done batches) in schedule_state.json; a batch whose research run record already exists is not run again; a snapshot that no longer re-derives abandons the cycle
design.scope: 171 time_series templates evaluated; 11 cross_sectional skipped with reason 'cross_sectional_scope' recorded in the cycle summary
design.authority: evaluation records metrics, evaluation_ref, status draft->evaluated and duplicate_of only; never active, approval or pool membership (test_evaluation_never_grants_active_or_pool_state)
design.result_record: run_alpha_template_evaluation per batch; each template's registry metadata alpha_template_evaluation.evaluation_context carries governed_snapshot_id, window, symbol_count, history_depth, symbol_selection and horizons_without_enough_observations
design.config_changes: alpha-replication-worker: REGISTRY_STORE_BACKEND/DSN, ALPHA_TEMPLATE_EVAL_* , mem_limit 512m -> 768m; research-orchestrator-svc: REGISTRY_STORE_BACKEND/DSN so GET /api/research/alpha-templates/evaluations can read the registry store on hosted

measurement.method: measure_hosted_scale.py in this directory: real DailyBarsStore parquet store (fixture random-walk prices, so it measures cost not signal), real DailyBarsReader/governed_market_dataset, real evaluator, memory registry, fresh subprocess; local machine, not the hosted container

run_300_symbols_800_days.symbol_selection: 60 most liquid of 300 boundary symbols (bounded: true, recorded in the result)

run_1500_symbols_800_days_first_3_steps.note: boundary of 1500 symbols + dataset load + 2 batches of 10; about 22 s per batch, so a full cycle is about 7 minutes

measurement.limit: peak 395 MiB fits the raised 768m worker limit with the controller process (about 50-100 MiB) beside it; the old 512m limit would have been marginal. Bound: ALPHA_TEMPLATE_EVAL_MAX_SYMBOLS (default 60 = governed_market_dataset.MAX_DATASET_SYMBOLS)
measurement.hosted: not measured here; the first hosted cycle's wall time and RSS (docker stats) are for the coordinator after deploy

tests.result: 10 passed (full 171-template cycles on the real evaluator, registry memory store)

review_independence_exception: other model families are at terminal quota until 2026-11-27 10:03Z, so the reviewer may be from the owner's family
residual_findings: GET /api/research/alpha-templates/evaluations/{id} returns research_run null for scheduled evaluations: their run records live in the worker's per-cycle store (the research service's shared JSON maps are not safe for a second writing process), the evaluation itself is in registry metadata and in the list route
the existing POST /api/research/alpha-templates/evaluate still writes into the research service's local registry store configuration and the shared research store; unchanged by this task
each batch re-derives the 11 cross-sectional/active context from the registry (list_all_entries); fine at 182 entries, would need a filtered read if the library grows by an order of magnitude
